Body.Content:
Store and trade-counter associates often need to source items from another store or warehouse and tell the customer when the item will arrive. This feature brings available-to-promise (ATP) data from Inventory Visibility together with transfer lead times in Store Commerce, so associates can choose the best location and set accurate delivery dates. This feature includes:

ATP and estimated arrival in inventory lookup: View ATP quantities and dates across locations, plus the estimated arrival date at the current store if a transfer order is created. Sort and filter results to find the best option.

ATP-by-date view: Drill into ATP by date for a selected location. Check forward (when the requested quantity can arrive) or backward (which locations can meet the requested quantity by a target date).

Transfer order estimated arrival: When you create a transfer order from POS, the estimated arrival date is calculated from transfer lead times (per mode of delivery, or the warehouse-pair default) and is recalculated when the ship date or mode of delivery changes.

Lead-time data in the channel: Transfer lead-time master data is synchronized from Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to the channel database through Commerce Data Exchange (CDX).

Headless ATP and transfer lead-time API on Commerce Scale Unit: A new channel-agnostic API returns ATP together with transfer-order estimated arrival dates in a single call, so Store Commerce, e-commerce storefronts, and first- or third-party headless channels can all use the same source of truth.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: October CY2026
